verdict.rationale: There is no documented 'export all data' feature, but the evidence points to low lock-in. GlitchTip can be self-hosted with Docker on a standard PostgreSQL backend, so you hold the raw data yourself. It accepts Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims for Sentry API compatibility, which makes switching away easier. Its built-in MCP server lets you pull your own error data into AI tools. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data in open formats (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps), an export path for hosted-instance users, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent reports of migrating data out.
